description: Reports on the pipeline runs started last in this window (by run_pipeline or by the person): whether any are still running, and each run's target, status, error and output files.

batch.description: The pipeline, running (true while any run is queued or going), and each run's target, status, error and output files.

useWhen: Check on runs that outlasted run_pipeline, or that the person started from the Pipelines view.

failures.meaning: Nothing has run in this window yet.
